Interface BuildingEffect

All Known Implementing Classes:
CavePaintingsFoodPerArtistEffect, DoubleBuilderEndGameEffect, DoubleShamanWinEffect, EndGamePointsPerCharacterTypeEffect, EndGamePointsPerCompleteSetEffect, ExtraDrawEffect, FlatEndGamePointsEffect, FoodFromTurnOrderBonusEffect, FoodPerCompletedSetEffect, FoodPerInventorPairEffect, HuntingRewardPerHunterEffect, NoLossIfLastShamanEffect, ShamanBonusStarsEffect, SustenanceDiscountPerTypeEffect
public interface BuildingEffect
Persistent effect attached to a building card. Every method has a no-op default implementation, so concrete effects only override the hooks they actually need to react to.

    • modifyTurnOrderFood

      default int modifyTurnOrderFood(Game game, Player player, int currentFood)
      Lets the effect modify the food delta granted by the turn order slot the player landed on.
      Parameters:
      game - current game instance
      player - the affected player
      currentFood - food delta computed so far
      Returns:
      the modified food delta

    • onCardTaken

      default void onCardTaken(Game game, Player player, Card card)
      Hook invoked whenever a card is taken by player. Useful for effects that track set / pair completion (e.g. inventor pairs).
      Parameters:
      game - current game instance
      player - the player who took the card
      card - the card that has just been taken
